overlay.description: 我们只做三类不可省略的改写，其余逐字保留上游原文。改写分两层：rewrites 是机械的字面约定替换（正则，对每个技能文件都生效，所以上游新增一处旧约定也会被自动改掉），patches 是逐条登记的语义改写（find 失配就报错，这是上游升级的信号）。
rules: pi 的调用约定不是 Claude Code 的 Skill tool：模型的技能调用走 /skill:<name> 或读取该技能的 SKILL.md，因此上游的 "Call the Skill tool with X" 一律改写为 "Use the `X` skill"。
上游 setup-matt-pocock-skills 产生的 docs/agents/issue-tracker.md 不是所有人都有的硬依赖，把硬依赖降级为软依赖（有则用，无则走后续回退）。
不复制 agents/openai.yaml（Codex UI 元数据，pi 不读）。
vendoring 后仍含 "Skill tool" 字样的文件直接报错：说明上游又添了一处旧约定，需要人来决定怎么改。

rewrites.pattern: ([Cc])all the Skill tool twice, for "([^"]+)" and "([^"]+)"\.
rewrites.replace: use the `$2` skill, then the `$3` skill.

rewrites.pattern: should call the Skill tool for

patches.find: The issue tracker should have been provided to you. If `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md` is missing, tell the user to run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills`.
patches.replace: The spec source may be an issue tracker. If `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md` exists it says how to fetch issues; if it does not, fall back to the spec sources in step 2.

patches.find: 1. Issue references in the commit messages (`#123`, `Closes #45`, GitLab `!67`, etc.), fetched via the workflow in `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md`.
patches.replace: 1. Issue references in the commit messages (`#123`, `Closes #45`, GitLab `!67`, etc.), fetched via the workflow in `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md` when that file exists.
